title: National Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) 50-State & DC Workforce & Board of Nursing Registry
description: Comprehensive, multi-source national registry of 12,211 active Certified Nurse-Midwives (CNMs) across all 50 U.S. States and the District of Columbia, linked across AMCB, CMS NPPES, Open Payments, and 50-State Boards of Nursing (BONs).
